description: Upstream Go tests deliberately left without a TypeScript counterpart, read by scripts/test-parity.mjs (pnpm test:parity). A key is "<Go import path>.<test name>", where "*" matches any run of characters. Every entry cites the ADR that decided it; the script fails if an ADR is missing, if an entry no longer matches anything, or if a listed test has since been ported.

*.Benchmark*.reason: Go benchmarks are not ported; vitest has no equivalent harness and none of them asserts behaviour.
